'''Trron Selus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served as a battle coordinator at [[Camp Conquest|Outpost Victory]], a stronghold of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Selus was among the casualties when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sacked the outpost.<ref name="Firestar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trron Selus appears as a named Champion enemy in Outpost Victory during the Heroic misison "Firestar," which can be completed by Imperial players on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Firestar" />
